entries.what: Slept until 9, then a slow morning with Iris before she left for the dental office; Noemi did a round of subnetting drills at the kitchen counter.
entries.outcome: Finished one drill set and marked the weak spots in her study guide.

entries.what: Ten-hour swing at RF-4 in the IT cage; Bao handled battery swaps while Noemi worked through the repair backlog and updated the RMA sheet.
entries.outcome: Cut the cage pile down, though several scanners still waited on vendor RMAs.

entries.what: Carla texted Noemi's cell about two dead scanners on the outbound dock near the end of shift; Noemi swapped them out before the handoff.
Election day: Noemi voted at the Vinca Avenue Community Center on the way to work, with Iris along.
entries.outcome: Voted on Measure K and council seats, got her sticker.

entries.what: Swing shift at RF-4 with Bao in the cage; the Tue 3-5 training block covered scanner trigger boards.
entries.outcome: Bao fixed a trigger board unassisted.

entries.what: Got home after 11:30, ate leftover rice with Iris, and watched the election chatter before bed.

Late morning, Noemi began looking at network tech openings outside Ridgeline, including St. Anselm IT, and asked her assistant for job-posting keywords, joking that she was just checking other servers.
entries.outcome: Saved a short list of keywords and three postings to apply to.

entries.what: Worked the swing shift, filling in for lead duties on vendor tickets and scheduling while Victor was on days.
Told Iris she was sending out applications; they talked it over late at the kitchen table.
entries.outcome: Iris offered to look at her resume.

entries.what: Drafted a reply to an email from Victor and rewrote it three times to strip out the sarcasm before sending.
Swing shift in the cage; Thursday training with Bao from 3 to 5 on battery contacts.
entries.outcome: Two more scanners returned to the floor.

entries.what: Iris's Thursday sushi was waiting when Noemi got home; they ate it after her shift.
Morning of practice-test questions, then a quick check on the job applications she had started.
Picked up Taquería Colima for her Friday shift meal and ate it in the IT cage next to the outbound break room.
Red-beep night on the outbound dock: many scanners failed and pickers fell behind rate, so Noemi spent the shift swapping units.
Walked the Ulloa marsh boardwalk in the morning, careful on the damp planks.
Worked the every-other-Saturday overtime shift at RF-4.
Home late, a quick chat with Iris, then collapsed.
Slept in, then helped her parents with their printer at the Vinca fourplex and saw her brother Mateo.
entries.outcome: Printer working again; Mateo asked about the PC build.

entries.what: Afternoon study session with the tabbed guide and subnetting problems.
Sunday night co-op survival game with her online squad as packetloss_.
